clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's worry over money and her move away from talking with your father about it, your brother's grades falling, and your mother's return to calm once back at work in early 1990. The shifts in these months cluster around the loss and its ripple through the household, with no shifts in anyone else's account showing at the same time.

clusters.name: Your mother's breast cancer diagnosis, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around your mother's breast cancer diagnosis in February 1995, within the following year: your migraines began in March 1994 after you left for college, you moved toward your brother with nightly calls, then in June 1995 you stopped returning his calls, and by February 1996 you had stopped calling home. Your shifts in relationship with your brother and with your mother sit beside your mother's diagnosis and the months after, with no one else's shifts showing in these dates.
